_about: All DEU runs and the standby after them on the reference unit, re-read on 2026-10-30. Raw states of 2026-10-22 05:12 to 2026-10-28 04:07 come from the recorder database in an automatic Home Assistant backup (opened read-only; the live recorder keeps about 5 days), later ones from live Home Assistant history via ha-mcp. Nothing was written to the unit for this analysis. Poll interval ~60 s, plus re-reads after a write. A time alone is the poll that first showed the value; (t1, t2] is bracketed by two polls. Only changes are recorded, so t1 is the latest earlier recorded poll. Times Europe/Vienna (UTC+2 up to 2026-10-25, then UTC+1).
unit: HRDS+ 30 R DC, headless, brine circuit (handbook variant 6: small own pump on PM, parallel to the heat pump), behind a ComfoAir Q350
software: Integration 0.9.4 on 2026-10-23 from 09:27 (update installed then); the 2026-10-22 run is on an earlier version. 0.9.5 installed 2026-10-23 22:33

findings.hold_is_not_from_the_last_compressor_eve: Run C's start came 18 min after a stop and 58 min after a start, with PE01 (300 s) and PE03 (420 s) long past, and still took as long as after 12 hours off. During the hold 1122 reads off, not wait_on. So the hold counts from the request or the fan. PE04 (180 s) alone does not fill it. HB 8.2 gives at least 7 minutes from activation.
findings.wait_on_is_the_min_off_time: 1122 shows wait_on after a stop while the request stays on, about 300 s (PE01), then on. Starts came well under 420 s after a stop, so PE03 is not counted from the stop. The shortest start-to-start was 361..480 s, which does not contradict PE03 between starts.
findings.self_stop_every_93_min: With the request on and no alarm the compressor stopped by itself 92, 94 and 93 min after starting, at 24..31 % output, below PE28 (52 rps); the evaporator rose to 15 C and it restarted. HB 6.3: below PE28 for longer than PE32 it switches off. PE32 reads 90, listed as seconds; 90 s would stop it far earlier, 90 min fits. Runs A and B ended sooner (26 and 39 min) and show no stop.
findings.fan_status_during_ps01: Polls between the damper opening and the fan starting read 1119 = off and 639 = 0 in all three runs (29, 32 and 61 s after the damper read). 1119 never read wait_on in any recorded poll. 639 went from 0 to 50 % in the poll in which 1119 read on.
findings.fan_stop: wait_off at 40 % seen at two stops; at stop B the fan read on at 50 % at 11:29:56 and off at 11:30:57, so the run-on fell between polls.
findings.al03_timing: Water stayed above PC07 (30 C) from (17:10:13, 17:11:12]; AL03 came (17:25:12, 17:26:12], 14..16 min later = PA16 (900 s). An earlier excursion from 17:02:12 ended under 30 C at 17:07:13 and raised nothing.
findings.al03_effect: AL03 ended the effective DEU request (1121 off, PU03 = 0) while the Modbus request was still on: compressor status off, valve, damper off, fan run-on. The valve sniffed after Pb03. AL03 cleared within 29 s of the Modbus request ending, with water at 34.3 C, above PC07 - PA17.
findings.al12: AL12 (high pressure) for one poll at 17:11:12, compressor status alarm, then wait_on; cleared by itself at 17:12:16.
findings.anti_stagnation: 2 h once after a clean stop (A); about 1 h after the sniff that followed stop C. No second clean stop followed by standby exists.
findings.headless_settings: PH01 (1777) = 0 and HA00 (1803) = 0 in the dumps of 2026-10-20 23:53 and 2026-10-23 11:59 and 20:21. Their entities show one value in all recorded history (off and none_or_external, through the backup and live to 2026-10-30).
